entries.title: I Chronicles 13:1
segments: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:2
segments: And David said unto all the assembly of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and if it be of Jehovah our God, let us send abroad every where unto our brethren that are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us;

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:3
segments: and let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we sought not unto it in the days of Saul.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:4
segments: And all the assembly said that they would do so; for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:5
segments: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor [the brook] of Egypt even unto the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:6
segments: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, [that is], to Kiriath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God Jehovah that sitteth [above] the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:7
segments: And they carried the ark of God upon a new cart, [and brought it] out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:8
segments: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:9
segments: And when they came unto the threshing-floor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:10
segments: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put forth his hand to the ark; and there he died before God.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:11
segments: And David was displeased, because Jehovah had broken forth upon Uzza; and he called that place Perez-uzza, unto this day.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:12
segments: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:13
segments: So David removed not the ark unto him into the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:14
segments: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months: and Jehovah blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.
